slices.focus: Rediscovering 1990s indie rock as the best soundtrack for labeling marathons during an archive-cleanout fundraiser
slices.summary: At a winter archive-cleanout fundraiser, Hannah rediscovers that late 1990s indie rock provides the ideal rhythm for sustained labeling work — familiar enough not to distract, structured enough to hold attention — and begins building a task-specific playlist.
open_loops: Build core playlist + rotating outer ring to avoid saturation
Test on labeling block and documentation cleanup separately
Keep ritual small: tea, playlist, labels, timer, stretch break
10-minute test: if still reorganizing pencils at minute 11, the ritual has become procrastination
decisions: Hannah now treats late 1990s indie rock as her favorite soundtrack for repetitive labeling and documentation sessions.
